title: A little idea.
A world of its own.
processStory.description: You bring the story. We find its shape, its colour, its character. Here’s how it comes together.

chapters.label: The idea
chapters.title: First, a feeling.
chapters.body: Before the colours and the type, there’s a conversation. What are you making? Who is it for? How should it feel?
chapters.detail: For Popice: joyful, bold and immediately refreshing.

chapters.label: The character
chapters.title: Then, a visual voice.
chapters.body: We explore the details that make an idea recognisable. A softer wordmark. A considered palette. A small mark with its own personality.
chapters.detail: A rounded wordmark, vivid pink and a repeating ice-lolly pattern.

chapters.label: The whole story
chapters.title: Made to belong together.
chapters.body: The direction becomes a family of pieces. Each one has a job to do. Every one feels like it belongs to the same story.
chapters.detail: From the wrapper to the banner on your screen.

processStory.endNote: A real identity, carried through every touchpoint.

process.title: A thoughtful way there.
process.description: You bring the story. We help find its visual voice.

steps.title: The conversation
steps.body: Tell us what you’re making, who it’s for and how you want it to feel. We shape a clear brief together.

steps.title: The creative direction
steps.body: We explore type, colour and composition, then build a direction around your story.

steps.title: The finishing touches
steps.body: We refine the details with your feedback and prepare the agreed artwork.

items.question: What can I work with Desira on?
items.answer: Custom logos and identities, posters, invitations, illustrations and event graphics. Tell us your idea and we’ll help define the scope.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Share what you’re creating, your references and your ideal timeline. We’ll discuss the brief and next steps.

items.question: How much will my project cost?
items.answer: Your quote depends on the deliverables, complexity and timeline. We agree on these details before starting.

items.question: Can you create something completely custom?
items.answer: Yes. Bring your story, references or an early idea. We’ll shape the design together.
